content.title: RAPP Stock Soars 62% in a Week on Meeting Phase II Epilepsy Study Goal
content.summary: Rapport Therapeutics stock jumps 62% in a week as mid-stage study of RAP-219 meets goals in drug-resistant epilepsy patients.

content.title: TVTX Stock Soars as FDA Waives Advisory Committee for Filspari sNDA
content.summary: Travere Therapeutics stock jumps after the FDA drops advisory meeting for Filspari's FSGS filing, with approval decision due in January 2026.

content.title: RARE Reports Positive Long-Term Data From Metabolic Disorder Study
content.summary: Ultragenyx posts 96-week data showing DTX401 sharply cuts cornstarch needs and improves life quality in GSDIa patients.

content.title: IMVT Stock Up 11% on Upbeat Batoclimab Hyperthyroidism Study Results
content.summary: Immunovant stock jumps 11% after new batoclimab study results showed durable thyroid hormone control in Graves' disease patients.

content.title: Editas Nominates EDIT-401 as Lead In Vivo Therapy for High Cholesterol
content.summary: EDIT nominates EDIT-401, a one-time in vivo gene editing therapy, as its lead pipeline candidate to cut the risk of elevated cholesterol.

content.title: Beat the Market the Zacks Way: Oracle, Intellia, Pharming Group in Focus
content.summary: Even in a choppy market, Zacks' strategies are spotlighting winners like Oracle, Intellia, and Pharming Group, proving the value of a disciplined, research-driven approach.

content.title: OTLK Stock Crashes 54% as FDA Issues Second CRL for Eye Disease Drug
content.summary: Outlook Therapeutics stock plunges 54% after the FDA rejects ONS-5010 BLA again, citing lack of efficacy data in confirmatory study.

content.title: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals Settles Firdapse Patent Litigation With Lupin
